subject: Honor FX-merged display order for falling-arrow refresh
description: Old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_037/replay-015-session-0001.jsonl.zst` first diverged after frame 1057 only because Projectile84 and Projectile85 received each other's falling-arrow sprite frames: Original exposed frames 5 and 3, while Rust exposed 3 and 5, with the RNG stream otherwise aligned. Original does not refresh arrows in an arrow-only depth order. `RHEngine::Refresh` first calls `SortForDisplay`, whose phase-three merge extracts each active non-animation element behind the current masking FX before appending that FX and the remaining elements; it then invokes every element's `Refresh` in that merged order (`original-code/RHengine.cpp:7724-7755,7978-7981,8032-8120`). A falling arrow's `RHElementArrow::Refresh` consumes `(rand() % 3) + 3` in precisely that presentation order (`original-code/RHElementArrow.cpp:318-337`). At the representative boundary, active Fx3's horizontal masking polyline from `(1007,843)` to `(1025,843)` classifies Projectile85 at map Y `834.396` as behind while Projectile84 at map Y `843.416` is not, extracting Projectile85 first and exactly explaining Original's RNG-frame ownership. Commit `5cabafcf33f9a370d379936ee92a90cec1a0dd74` makes the deferred arrow refresh filter the engine's existing authoritative full display order instead of independently sorting arrows by world Y. Its focused lifecycle regression constructs two depth-sorted falling arrows and a masking FX, proves the merge reverses their relative order, and verifies distinct seeded RNG frames reach the correct owners; it passes 1/1. The exact two-file scope is `crates/robin_engine/src/engine/tick.rs` and `crates/robin_engine/src/engine/tests/lifecycle.rs`, with formatting and diff checks clean. Authoritative optimized runner SHA-256 `a302025592f5769ebc0869b3983cfe9dcb647f97b800c244de2af73c1f55233d` matches the representative and adjacent control `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_037/replay-012-session-0001.jsonl.zst` through exact EOF, both with exit status 0.
